sn9.10:1.2: The verb _saṅkasāyati_ is a synonym of _allīyati_, to stick or adhere to ([pli-tv-kd3:1.2.3]()).
sn9.10:2.1: BB has “Dhamma-stanzas” for dhammapadani. However the word appears only rarely in this sense in the EBTs, and where it does—at AN 4.191—it is clearly said with reference to all nine angas, not just verses. There, BB has “passages of the Dhamma”, which I follow.
